summary: Iter49: verified (a) new Payment Dashboard backend + UI and (b) Approval double-submit prevention on both backend (atomic optimistic lock) and frontend (confirmBusy guard). 4/4 backend tests pass; UI verified in Playwright. One minor route-guard leak identified for center_manager on /payment-dashboard (page renders even though API is 403).

integration_issues.issue: ProtectedRoute has an OPS_DASHBOARD_ROLES bypass (ProtectedRoute.jsx line 36) that lets center_manager render ANY requireFinance route (not just '/'). Direct navigation to /payment-dashboard as center_manager renders the full PaymentDashboard page (empty charts because API returns 403). Sidebar link is correctly hidden. Recommend: apply the OPS bypass only for path '/' (RoleHome) OR redirect to LANDING_FOR_ROLE for all non-finance roles on non-root routes.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Tighten ProtectedRoute.jsx OPS_DASHBOARD_ROLES bypass so it only applies to path '/' (RoleHome), not to every requireFinance route. Currently center_manager can render /payment-dashboard shell (data is safely 403 from backend, so this is UX/security-in-depth, not data leak).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/approvals/act atomic lock correctly serializes concurrent duplicate approvals — the pre-check on status also catches serialized duplicates (returns 400 'Already finalised') — combined guarantee: at most one success across N concurrent clicks. Verified with 4 parallel threads.

Payment Dashboard endpoint returns the exact contract (kpis, daily_series[30], weekly_series, monthly_series, center_wise, project_wise, income_breakdown, meta.filter_applied). Filter round-trip is echoed correctly in meta.
Frontend confirmBusy state on PendingApprovals blocks duplicate POSTs — verified 6 rapid clicks resulted in exactly 1 POST to /api/approvals/act.
Minor: PaymentDashboard.jsx uses api.get('/dashboard/payment-summary') — good, no hardcoded URL. Uses process.env indirectly via api client.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (PD render, filter refetch, refresh, sidebar RBAC, confirmBusy guard all verified)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing pending approvals inbox (126 items). Approved one Advance during frontend guard test (inbox 126→125).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend double-submit test uses 4 parallel threads with barrier sync; in practice observed outcome was 1×200 + 3×400 (Already finalised via pre-check) — this is functionally equivalent to the 409 lock; the atomic lock only trips when interleaving happens inside the ~1ms window between pre-check and update. Primary invariant asserted: exactly one 200 success, all others 400 or 409. Backend endpoint POST returns 200 with {ok:true,status:'approved'}. Payment Dashboard endpoint at /api/dashboard/payment-summary is fast and safe. UI testids verified: pd-kpi-{daily,weekly,monthly,upcoming}, pd-chart-{daily,weekly,monthly,center,project,income}, pd-filter-{center,partner,project,start,end,reset}, pd-refresh-btn.
rca of the issue: Not a functional bug — the ProtectedRoute OPS bypass appears overly broad; low priority since API RBAC still returns 403 and no data leaks.
